question: Which CLDN18.2 result includes the patient from being eligible for the clinical trial "NCT07103668" ?
reference_answer: Patients need an archived or newly collected tumor sample (primary or metastatic) tested by a central lab, showing positive CLDN18.2 staining (≥40% positive tumor cell rate and ≥2+ staining intensity). If they've already had other CLDN18.2-targeted therapies, they’ll need to provide a sample collected after that treatment to retest and check their CLDN18.2 levels.

relevant.quote: Tumor tissue specimens (primary or metastatic, archived or newly collected) from subjects are expected to be available and tested by a central laboratory, indicating positive histological staining for CLDN18.2 (defined as a positive tumor cell rate ≥40% and a staining intensity ≥2+) . If the subject has previously received other CLDN18.2-targeted therapies, tumor tissue specimens collected after that treatment are required to retest and evaluate CLDN18.2 expression levels .

question: Which biomarker result excludes the patient from being eligible for the clinical trial "NCT07103668" ?
reference_answer: Anyone testing positive—as confirmed by the central lab—for HIV (antibody positive), Hepatitis B (HBsAg positive and/or HBc antibody positive, plus HBV-DNA positive), acute or chronic active Hepatitis C (HCV antibody positive and HCV-RNA positive), syphilis (antibody positive), Epstein-Barr virus (IgM positive), CMV (IgM positive), HTLV (positive), or COVID-19 (if it doesn't turn negative within 7 days). It also covers anyone with known positive HER2 expression (defined as IHC 3+, or IHC 2+ and FISH+).

relevant.quote: Positive human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) antibody test; hepatitis B virus infection ( HBsAg positive and/or HBc antibody positive, and HBV-DNA positive ); acute or chronic active hepatitis C (HCV antibody positive and HCV-RNA positive ); positive syphilis antibody test; Epstein-Barr virus infection (IgM positive); cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection (IgM positive) ; human T- lymphotropic virus ( HTLV ) positive; positive for novel coronavirus (COVID-19) and not reverting to negative within 7 days . The above pathogen test results are subject to the central laboratory test results.
Known HER2 expression is positive (defined as IHC 3+, or IHC 2+ and FISH+).

question: Do trials "NCT03504397" and "NCT07385703" require the same CLDN18.2 expression threshold for patient inclusion?
reference_answer: No. Trial NCT03504397 requires CLDN18.2 expression in ≥ 75% of tumor cells with moderate to strong membranous staining, whereas trial NCT07385703 defines positive CLDN18.2 expression at a lower threshold of ≥ 25% tumor cell membrane staining intensity 2+ and 3+.

relevant.quote: Subject's tumor expresses CLDN18.2 in ≥ 75% of tumor cells demonstrating moderate to strong membranous staining as determined by central immunohistochemistry (IHC) testing.

Archived specimens or fresh tumor tissue specimens from ≤3 years ago must be provided for CLDN18.2 and PD-L1 testing (PD-L1 results are not a condition for enrollment). When multiple samples are present, the most recent accessible and qualified sample must be provided. After confirmation by the central laboratory, tumor tissue with positive CLDN18.2 expression is defined as ≥25% tumor cell membrane staining intensity 2+ & 3+. For patients who have previously received radical neoadjuvant chemotherapy or adjuvant chemotherapy (radiotherapy) based on platinum-containing combination chemotherapy regimens, newly obtained tissue from recurrent or metastatic lesions must be provided for CLDN18.2 and PD-L1 testing.
